messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered INC-2026 — metering anomaly detected in eu-west-1. Token-count drift vs expected. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026 :rotating_light:

sam_oncall: oncall sam here, grabbing it. will run quick checks and follow runbook.

alex_ops: seeing increased lag on emitter-consumer in eu-west-1, backlog ~45k messages. redis consumer offsets stalled. :eyes:

priya_billing: some customers already got overage flags from the billing pipeline. Not yet customer-visible invoices but flags triggered alerts. pulling example logs now.

priya_billing: ```
metric: tokens_emitted
window: 2026-03-20T01:50-02:00Z
emitted: 124512
expected: 126000
delta: -1488
notice: shadow_export continued while ingest lag happened
```

sam_oncall: confirmed. seems like shadow export continued and our reconciliation scaled against stale emit metadata. stepping to pause exports. who can flip the export circuit-breaker?

alex_ops: I can flip. running pause on shadow-export for eu-west-1. command: `curl -XPOST https://admin.redwood/flags/emit_pause -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","reason":"token-drift"}'`

alex_ops: response 200 OK — shadow-export paused. :white_check_mark:

priya_billing: pausing export suppressed further overage flag emissions. I pushed a temporary rule to ignore flags created after 2026-03-20T01:45Z to avoid noisy alerts.

ben_sre: nice. i'm spinning up a read-only reconciliation job to re-evaluate the delta without shadow counts. command: `kubectl exec -it reconcile-01 -- /app/reconciler --dry-run --region eu-west-1`

ben_sre: dry run shows the majority of drift is from a single emitter shard that stalled and retried, causing double-emit window overlap. likely a consumer ack bug.

maria_cs: cs here — which customers are impacted? we need a short statement for customers who received overage flags.

priya_billing: quick list: acct-1283, acct-9912, acct-4471 show transient flags. all have <24h usage delta. will assemble an advisory.

sam_oncall: mitigation steps summary: 1) paused shadow-export (alex) 2) suppressed post-window flagging (priya) 3) started dry-run recon (ben). Next: restart consumers with fresh offsets to clear backlog, then replay with de-dup safeguards. ETA 20-30m.

alex_ops: restarting consumer group eu-west-1/emitter-consumer-3 with `k restart consumer/emitter-consumer-3 --grace 30s`. restart issued.

alex_ops: restart completed, offsets rebased. backlog processing speed normalizing. :thumbsup:

ben_sre: recon dry-run shows reconciliation delta dropping. will promote to real reconcile after one more window of verification.

maria_cs: drafting customer note: "We observed transient billing flagging due to a metering emitter backlog in eu-west-1. We paused exports and suppressed duplicate flags. No invoices have been issued. We'll follow up with a correction if needed." Want to approve? @sam_oncall @priya_billing

sam_oncall: approve. add estimated follow-up timeline (within 24h) and contact cs@redwood.com.

priya_billing: agreed. sending advisory now to the 3 accounts. tagging support to watch for replies.

incident-bot: Update INC-2026 — mitigation in place, immediate customer impact contained. Status: mitigated (export paused + consumer restart). Postmortem owners: ben_sre (root cause), alex_ops (ops runbook), priya_billing (billing impact). Next update in 30m or when recon finishes.

ben_sre: assigning ticket #TKT-558 to track root cause and remediation (consumer ack fix + test to prevent replay).

alex_ops: will add a quick circuit-breaker runbook step to the incident guide so pause + suppress is an explicit play.

maria_cs: thanks team, i'll follow up with customers and link the advisory to the incident page. :pray:

sam_oncall: closing the pager for now. please keep updates in this thread if anything regresses.

incident-bot: Pager resolved for on-call. If new symptoms appear, reopen INC-2026 or notify #incidents immediately.
